stories.title: Man and two children taken to hospital after crash
stories.summary: Two children and a man have been taken to hospital after a crash involving a car and pedestrians.

stories.title: Decision-makers not part of i360 review, council told
stories.summary: The report says the council had been given "over-ambitious" forecasts for the attraction.

stories.title: Plans for woodland the size of 800 football pitches
stories.summary: The South Downs National Park plans to create 500 hectares of woodland across Sussex and Hampshire.

stories.title: Domestic abuse survivor warns 'look for red flags'

stories.summary: Sussex Police apologise to Jason Pulman’s family for not acting urgently after he went missing

stories.summary: Sarah Willingham says she is worried about the Brighton i360's future, criticising the city council.

stories.title: Stage suit worn by Max Miller going to museum

stories.title: Samaritans closing at 'worst time', say volunteers
stories.summary: Volunteers at the Worthing branch deliver a petition to the charity's Ewell headquarters.

stories.title: Horsham's Marco Penge wins first PGA Tour title
